name: lci_radio_config
description: LCI /config/radio CBOR vectors (spec 17.5.2): GET responses and PUT update payloads emitted by RadioConfigResource, plus rejection cases reflecting its verified behavior (4.01 unauthenticated writes, 4.00 for empty/non-map bodies and unknown keys).

vectors.name: get_spec_example_radio
vectors.description: GET /config/radio response matching the spec 17.5.2 example (906.875 MHz encodes as CBOR float64).

vectors.name: get_eu868_radio
vectors.description: EU868-flavoured radio configuration with reduced TX power.

vectors.name: get_minimal_radio
vectors.description: Partial radio configuration exposing only two keys.

vectors.name: get_empty_radio
vectors.description: Fresh node with no radio configuration returns an empty CBOR map.

vectors.name: put_spec_update_changed
vectors.description: PUT /config/radio partial update from spec 17.5.2 merges into state.

vectors.name: get_sf_bounds
vectors.description: Edge: spreading factor at both LoRa bounds (SF7 and SF12).

vectors.name: get_negative_tx_power
vectors.description: Edge: negative TX power encodes as CBOR negative integer.

vectors.name: get_meshtastic_sync_word
vectors.description: Edge: Meshtastic sync word value 0x2B (reflash coexistence note, spec README).

vectors.name: put_empty_payload_bad_request
vectors.description: Empty PUT body to /config/radio is rejected 4.00.

vectors.name: put_unknown_key_atomic_reject
vectors.description: Unknown radio key rejects 4.00 atomically; no field is applied.
vectors.note: 'bandwidth_khz' is not a provisioned key ('bw_khz' is); nothing mutates.

vectors.name: put_non_map_cbor_bad_request
vectors.description: CBOR text string body is rejected 4.00 (updates must be a map).
vectors.note: encoded_hex of a bare string is pinned only as the malformed request body.
